summary.en: Drone strikes have hit two power stations in eastern Sudan, causing a widespread blackout and prompting Sudan to lodge complaints with the UN and African Union against Ethiopia for cross-border attacks. The RSF continues to use drones against civilian infrastructure, while the UN is preparing talks with the RSF on a civilian transition. Sudan’s government has accused Ethiopia of supporting the attacks, and the conflict has expanded to include disputes over the power grid. 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Droneangrep har rammet to kraftstasjoner i Øst-Sudan, noe som har forårsaket et omfattende strømbrudd og fått Sudan til å sende inn klager til FN og Den afrikanske union mot Etiopia for grenseoverskridende angrep. RSF-militsen fortsetter å bruke droner mot sivil infrastruktur, mens FN forbereder samtaler med RSF om en sivil overgang. Sudans regjering har anklaget Etiopia for å støtte angrepene, og konflikten har utvidet seg til å omfatte tvister om strømnettet. 4 680 drepte i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Sudanese civil war (2023–present)
background.extract: Since April 2023, there has been a civil war in Sudan between the two main factions of the country's military government. The conflict involves the internationally recognized government of Sudan led by the Sudanese Armed Forces (SAF), under General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan; against the rival Government of Peace and Unity led by the Rapid Support Forces (RSF) paramilitary group, commanded by General Hemedti. Smaller armed groups have also taken part on both sides, most notably Sudan Liberation Movement splinter groups, the Tamazuj militia, and the Darfur Joint Protection Force.
background.extractNb: Konflikten i Sudan 2023 er en pågående væpnet konflikt mellom rivaliserende fraksjoner i Sudans regjering som brøt ut den 15. april 2023 over hele landet. Konflikten er hovedsakelig i hovedstaden Khartoum og i Darfurregionen.
